1358-1742-1978-3363.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
1358-1742-1978-3363.description:
Animate The One Ring using Sydri.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

512-2691-4644.easyPrerequisites: Ilysian Caryatid and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-2691-4644.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
512-2691-4644.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Ilysian Caryatid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

971-2464-4687.notablePrerequisites:
Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
971-2464-4687.description:
Activate Song of Freyalise by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

628-728-7189.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-5468.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2034-2415-5468.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Repeat.

348-443-1152-2992-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-443-1152-2992-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Magus of the Bridge triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

2452-3249-3967-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1939-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
1939-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

4872-5913-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-5231-7188.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

539-1315-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1829-4905-5220-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

394-3705-4050-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the creature token, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-2921-4871-5921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

360-3490-4050-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
360-3490-4050-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Soul Warden indestructible.
360-3490-4050-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1902-4824-5963.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1902-4824-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Wirewood Channeler's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

710-772-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1537-5640-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1537-5640-5917.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, targeting Zealous Conscripts.
Resolve the copy of The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve the Jolly Ballon Man ability from step 2, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Activate the mana-producing creature token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

3284-3967-4550-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3284-3967-4550-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

4050-5853-5929.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
4050-5853-5929.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Snail, adding one mana of any color.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Leyline of Transformation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.
4050-5853-5929.notes: If you have mana available, you may instead sacrifice the Snails to Wick's ability.

4644-5329-5475.description:
Activate either of the creatures by tapping it, targeting the other creature.
If the tapped creature was a Merfolk, Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, untapping the targeted creature.
Repeat.

67-2511-2525.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, it triggers its Reveillark ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

526-1817-2781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1817-2781.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Felidar Guardian spell.
Resolve the copy of the Felidar Guardian spell.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any creature you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Felidar Guardian token.
Repeat from step 4.

2569-3957-4289-4452.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
"Merfolk" chosen with Rukarumel.
2569-3957-4289-4452.description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

933-1530-1927-3544.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
933-1530-1927-3544.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turh after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Auramancer.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

224-2366-2532-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
224-2366-2532-4050.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
The Dryad Arbor token enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dryad Arbor token, adding {R}.
The Dryad Arbor token dies, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

422-524-3263.description:
Aether Storm prevents creature spells from being cast.
Darksteel Forge prevents Aether Storm from being destroyed due to its ability.

745-1061-3499.notablePrerequisites:
Ghastly Mimicry attached to Timestream Navigator.
You have the city's blessing.
745-1061-3499.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Ghastly Mimicry triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the Timestream Navigator copy by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

2842-4050-4350-5189.notablePrerequisites: Butcher Ghoul does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2842-4050-4350-5189.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul, adding {1}.
Butcher Ghoul's undying ability and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Butcher Ghoul undying trigger, returning Butcher Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing a player to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Butcher Ghoul, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
